quote: ALTER TABLE facts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS embedding vector(1536);
why: Migration 009 (007/008 are taken) creates the extension at line 5, the vector(1536) column at line 7, the ivfflat index at lines 11-12 and the partial NULL index at lines 15-16. The module test asserts these exact snippets (tests/memory/test_embeddings.py:45-65). Live check: pgvector/pgvector:pg16 (extversion 0.8.7) applied 001+003+009 cleanly. The stale ticket's 007 path is superseded by the premise correction.

The Fact dataclass gains embedding at line 81; to_dict emits it at line 108 and from_dict restores it at line 127 (absent -> None). tests/memory/test_embeddings.py:71-91 round-trips both a populated and a None embedding and passes.

The write seam is FactStore.add_fact (there is no MemoryService); it generates the vector before repo.store at line 92. _embed calls LLMClient.embed at line 53 on fact.natural_lang_repr or fact.symbolic_repr (line 48). main.py:242 wires it: "fact_store = FactStore(fact_repo, llm_client=cortex.llm_client)". Both new-fact and mutable-duplicate paths embed; a STATIC duplicate is intentionally returned unchanged. A live probe through FactStore.add_fact stored a 1536-dim vector and the ANN search found it.

The ANN branch orders by cosine distance and LIMITs 50 (lines 148-154, 192), but it never raises ivfflat.probes (default 1) or enables ivfflat.iterative_scan; grep finds no such setting in src/. Measured on live pgvector 0.8.7 with migrations 001/003/009 and 5,062 embedded facts: PostgresFactRepository.search(query_embedding=[0.25,0.75,0,...]) returned 43 rows, while a seq scan returns the true top 50 and the same query with ivfflat.probes=10 returns 50. AC-4 requires the top 50 candidates, so this fails at any volume where the probed list holds <50 rows, and fact_types/min_confidence filters reduce the count further. Even when a list holds >=50 rows, probing one list does not guarantee the true top 50, so recall is also unverified. The unit test tests/memory/test_fact_repository.py:191 mocks DbSession and fabricates 50 rows, so AC-6 stays green without exercising the index.

When query_embedding is None the ILIKE predicate is preserved with the original %query% parameter and the lexical default of 10 rows (lines 148-162); ANN is selected only when query_embedding is not None (line 152). tests/memory/test_fact_repository.py:239-260 covers ILIKE plus filters; a live repo.search("probe") returned the stored fact. The issue's 'pgvector unavailable' / degraded_dimensions fallback is explicitly deferred by its Boundaries section, so its absence is out of scope here.

Full suite at 02703e1: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -> 1340 passed, 32 skipped, 0 failed. The 32 skips are 4 docker-compose e2e tests (docker-compose unavailable) and 28 evidence-engine tests (#83 not landed); none are pgvector. The new tests/memory/test_embeddings.py and tests/memory/test_fact_repository.py pass. Note the tests mock DbSession, so they do not catch the AC-4 index-recall failure.

ADR-0008's elements are present: eager store-time embedding (fact_store.py:92), the provider endpoint via LLMClient.embed (line 53; OpenAIClient defaults to text-embedding-3-small/1536 from #30), ILIKE fallback (repository.py:158) and pgvector ANN (repository.py:154). Advisory: docs/adr/0003-split-memory-service.md:10 still states FactStore has 'No LLM', which this change makes false; ADR-0008 does not record that supersession. ADR-0008's degraded_dimensions fallback is deferred by the issue's own Boundaries section (#32), so it is not a failure of this slice.

quote: | `facts`, `concepts` | Memory: typed facts (payload + confidence + layer + `vector(1536)` embedding, ADR-0008) and derived concepts |
why: The persistence table row names vector(1536) and ADR-0008 at line 343, and the deployment table names pgvector/pgvector:pg16 at line 362; docker-compose.yml:8 is the same image. A tree grep finds no remaining postgres:16-alpine outside the negative test assertion at tests/memory/test_embeddings.py:65.

The asyncpg wire format is the expected text literal plus cast: _vector_literal at line 17, store uses $7::vector at line 48, update uses $i::vector at line 106 and _parse_vector handles text/NULL/sequences at line 328. The FactRepository ABC gained search(query_embedding=...) and backfill_embeddings (interfaces.py:85-112, 195-207), and the Fact dataclass/FactStore seam follow the existing conventions. A live asyncpg probe round-tripped 1536 floats through store/get/update/backfill and returned 50 ANN rows; ruff and mypy pass on the changed memory files.

quote: ON facts USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);
why: 009 follows 008; the runner sorts *.sql and applies each unfiltered version once (src/cortex/db/migrations/runner.py:55-75), and every statement uses IF NOT EXISTS so re-runs are safe. The migration applied cleanly in the runner's transaction on pgvector 0.8.7. Advisory: the ivfflat index is created while facts.embedding is still all NULL (the column was just added), and pgvector emits 'NOTICE: ivfflat index created with little data' / 'DETAIL: This will cause low recall' / 'HINT: Drop the index until the table has more data.'; backfill_embeddings does not REINDEX. Consider creating the ANN index after backfill or documenting a REINDEX.

Resolved. The SET is at repository.py:187, inside the same 'async with DbSession() as db' block and before the fetch at line 188, gated by 'if query_embedding is not None' (line 186); the lexical branch never runs it. DbSession.__aenter__ acquires one pooled connection and both execute and fetch use self._conn (src/cortex/db/session.py:29-65), so the fetch cannot run on a different connection; a spy on DbSession.fetch observed SHOW ivfflat.probes = 10 at fetch time. Re-measured on a freshly rebuilt 5,062-fact pgvector 0.8.7 database: a sampled query for which probes=1 returned 42 rows returned 50 through the fixed repository. The original probes=10 control on the 43-row reproduction also returned 50. test_ann_search_sets_ivfflat_probes passes; full suite 1341 passed, 32 skipped.

quote: Supersedes ADR-0003's 'no LLM' clause for FactStore: embeddings are generated at write
why: Resolved. ADR-0008 lines 15-16 now record: 'Supersedes ADR-0003's 'no LLM' clause for FactStore: embeddings are generated at write time; the store still owns no event bus or concept cascade.' ADR-0003 remains a historical record, which is the correct ADR convention; the supersession is now discoverable from ADR-0008.

quote: -- REINDEX INDEX idx_facts_embedding; to rebuild it over the new vectors.
why: Resolved. The migration comment at lines 9-12 and the backfill_embeddings docstring at src/cortex/memory/repository.py:309-314 now document that the ivfflat index is built before bulk embedding and that a REINDEX INDEX idx_facts_embedding is required after a large backfill. The operational follow-up is documented exactly as the advisory requested.
